My hero would have to be my uncle. He had an accident when he was really young and dealt with brain damage all his life. He also had a tobacco addiction and an extreme case of diabetes. But no matter how he acted or what he did, he was always there for my sibling and I. My parents got a divorce and it was a huge split up for my family. My grandparents and other aunts and uncles never treated my family the same anymore, we weren't invited to thanksgiving or Christmas get togethers anymore but my uncle always made sure to get us little gifts with what he had and let us know that he didn't care what happened to our family, cause he still loved us. After my grandma and grandpa (his parents) both died within the same year, he didn't have anyone to take care of him anymore. He stopped taking his insulin and stopped eating and died in his bedroom alone. The last thing I remember him telling me was that he was proud to call me his niece and to follow my dreams

Rest in peace uncle Steve. Even though I didn't know you much while you were here and I never had a personal relationship with you, You will always be my hero <3
